reviews.review:
I’ve been an enthusiastic supporter of your project since day one, and I wanted to take a moment to express my appreciation for the tremendous work you’ve put into creating such a remarkable experience. Hockey Legacy Manager has quickly become my favorite sports management game, and I also proudly own the Basketball and Football series. Each title is a master class in management simulation, and it’s hard to imagine how you could improve on them — yet you somehow keep finding ways to do so.

That said, there’s one feature I’ve been hoping to see added over the years, and I thought I’d share my thoughts. I think it would be fantastic if the coach could actively manage the roster throughout the regular season, much like they do during the preseason. I tend to play with low injury settings and often simulate a month at a time. However, when no injuries occur, my scratch players end up spending the entire season without any ice time. It would be a game-changer if the coach could automatically rotate players in and out of the lineup, mirroring the dynamic substitutions of the preseason.

To add more depth, it could be interesting to introduce coaching styles or preferences — for example, certain coaches favoring veterans over rookies, prioritizing physicality over finesse, or emphasizing defensive stability over offensive creativity when setting the lineup. This would give roster management even more personality and realism.

As a stretch goal, I would also love to see enhancements to the player photo system — ideally allowing for larger, higher-quality images so that action shots could be used, making the rosters feel even more alive.

Once again, thank you for the incredible work you’ve put into these games. Your dedication and attention to detail do not go unnoticed, and I look forward to continuing to support the Hockey Legacy Manager series — and every other project you create — in the years to come.
